description:
Apply the app-monitor cutover pattern to every other scenario that still integrates with app-issue-tracker. Hard cutover only — no compat shims, no fallbacks, no dead code.

## Identified Consumers (from `rg 'app-issue-tracker' scenarios/`)

- **scenario-auditor** — substantial integration: `api/handlers_issue_tracker.go`, `api/agent_manager.go`, `api/protected_scenarios_store.go`, `api/rules/config/setup_steps.go`, `api/rules/structure/test_coverage.go`, UI `ReportIssueDialog.tsx`, `RulesManager.tsx`, `ManageProtectedScenariosDialog.tsx`.
- **deployment-manager** — `ui/src/pages/Deployments.tsx`, `ui/src/components/GuidedFlow.tsx`, plus docs/scenarios refs.
- **prd-control-tower** — `api/issues.go`.
- **landing-manager** — `api/handlers/customize.go`, `api/errors/errors.go`, `ui/src/components/AgentCustomizationForm.tsx`.
- **secrets-manager** — `ui/src/sections/TierReadiness.tsx`.
- **agent-inbox** — `api/domain/types.go`.
- **scenario-dependency-analyzer** — `api/internal/app/analysis_test.go` (test-only).
- **vrooli-orchestrator** — `initialization/postgres/seed.sql`.
- **swarm-manager itself** — `requirements/18-app-issue-tracker-integration/module.json` (rewrite or retire).
- **prompt-manager team docs / agent SOULs** referencing AIT (oss-advertiser) — text-only updates.

Re-run the inventory at start; treat the list above as a hint, not authoritative.

## Per-Scenario Procedure (apply uniformly)
1. Map each AIT call to its swarm-manager equivalent using the doc produced by `app-monitor-issue-tracker-cutover-verify`.
2. Replace, don't wrap. Delete the AIT client/types/handlers; add swarm-manager calls in their place.
3. Update service.json depends_on, env wiring, and any deployment manifests.
4. Update or delete tests; do not keep AIT mocks 'just in case'.
5. Sweep docs and CLAUDE.md / memory references in the same scenario.
6. Confirm `rg 'app-issue-tracker'` for that scenario returns zero non-removal-history hits.

## Out of Scope
- The app-issue-tracker scenario directory itself (handled by the deprecation chore).
- App-monitor (handled by the verify item).

## Acceptance
- Repo-wide `rg -n 'app-issue-tracker|appIssueTracker|app_issue_tracker' scenarios/ | grep -v 'scenarios/app-issue-tracker/'` returns zero non-historical matches.
- All affected scenarios build and pass their own tests with app-issue-tracker NOT running.
name: cross-scenario-issue-tracker-cutover-sweep
title: Hard-Cutover All Remaining Scenarios Off App-Issue-Tracker to Swarm-Manager
